title: Kachalka
description: A journey into the heart of Kiev’s enormous open-air gym: Kachalka. This observational film follows the gym’s caretaker as he takes us through the enormous scrap-metal site, catching glimpses of various intriguing workouts while sharing the meanings attached to this “sacred place”.
producers: Ken Wardrop Motherland traces the experiences of two Jamaican-born Brits who have been forcibly returned to their “home
